title: The metaverse is dead but spatial computing is just getting started

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The metaverse promised a digital utopia — and it crashed hard.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: But spatial computing is quietly taking over our world right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s the tech that lets your phone know where you are in 3D space.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Apple’s new AR features use advanced mapping to track your surroundings in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This changes how we interact with devices, from shopping to healthcare.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future isn’t virtual — it’s smart, spatial, and here.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s the first thing you’ll use spatial computing for?

caption_text: The metaverse is dead but spatial computing is just getting started
